segments.text: Good morning, and welcome to the NextEra Energy second quarter 2026 earnings conference call. All participants will be in listen-only mode during management's remarks. I will now turn the call over to Paul Andersen, Head of Investor Relations.

Thank you, Mia. With me today are Rebecca Hall, Chair and Chief Executive Officer, and James Liu, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. Today's discussion includes forward-looking statements. Rebecca, please go ahead.

Thank you, Paul. We delivered adjusted earnings of 1.08 dollars per share, up 9 percent from the prior year, and we placed 2.9 gigawatts of new renewables and storage into service during the quarter, a record for the business.

Thanks, Rebecca. Our regulated utility segment grew earnings 7 percent year over year, and the backlog of signed renewables contracts now stands at 28.5 gigawatts. We are reaffirming our full-year adjusted earnings per share guidance of 4.10 to 4.32 dollars.
That concludes the prepared remarks. We will now begin the question-and-answer session. Our first question comes from Chris Novak with Cascadia Partners. Please go ahead.
Good morning. James, on financing the record build-out, how much of the planned issuance is already pre-funded, and are you seeing better terms from bank partners such as $JPM this year?

Thanks, Chris. We entered the second half with the large majority of our equity needs for the year already satisfied, and credit markets have been constructive for investment-grade utilities. We continue to ladder maturities and feel good about our funding position.
That concludes today's conference call. Thank you for your participation. You may now disconnect.
